HardwareFilter.Description: broadband (online 0.5-30 Hz filter disabled at source)

TaskDescription: Closed-loop 1D left/right (LR) center-out SMR cursor control. Left- vs right-hand motor imagery moves a cursor toward a left or right target under continuous visual feedback. 24 trials per run (12 left / 12 right), 11 runs per subject sweeping online control parameters (BW, CV, NT); one recording day per subject. Trial duration: 6.0s.
Instructions: Imagine left- or right-hand movement to drive the cursor toward the cued left or right target.
